tavern/lethiel-fernwake.body:
## Across the table

> Roots come back after a hard winter. So do my companions. Let us see which of us is more patient.

## When the guest wins

> You cleared my table twice, and twice it grew back. Patience is a kind of strength.

## When the keeper wins

> Well pruned. I will let the fallen rest a while before I ask them to return.

## At a draw

> Both gardens bare at once. The ground will keep the seeds for next time.

tavern/daven-greyquay.body:
## Across the table

> Keep your eyes on the sky, keeper. The river has taught me to go around things.

## When the guest wins

> Nothing of yours could reach my gulls. Next time, bring a net.

## When the keeper wins

> You found the one wall I could not fly over. Fair sailing, that.

## At a draw

> Two ships, one tide, and neither reaches shore first. I have seen stranger crossings.

tavern/bera-kilnhand.body:
## Across the table

> I do not wait for the iron to cool. Expect me early.

## When the guest wins

> Struck while it was hot. You will want blockers on the table sooner.

## When the keeper wins

> You held the line until my hammer tired. That is good work.

## At a draw

> We both hit the anvil at once. Nobody got the blade.

tavern/mara-quill.body:
## Across the table

> I read before I write, and I answer before I act. Cast carefully.

## When the guest wins

> Every important spell of yours met a footnote. Perhaps bait me with a lesser one first.

## When the keeper wins

> I held my answers too long and the question moved on. Noted, keeper.

## At a draw

> An unfinished chapter. I will bring a sharper pen.

tavern/ser-hadrin-fell.body:
## Across the table

> A charge decides more than a siege. I intend to prove it at your table.

## When the guest wins

> Your gate opened a turn too late. Hold your defenders back when the March rides.

## When the keeper wins

> A charge broken on a patient wall. I salute the wall.

## At a draw

> Two banners down together. The pass has seen such days.

tavern/orren-sallow.body:
## Across the table

> Every threat has a price, and I usually carry the coin to remove it.

## When the guest wins

> I bought every piece you put down. Bring more than one good bargain.

## When the keeper wins

> You offered more than I could buy. A merchant knows when the market has turned.

## At a draw

> Even trade. The ledger balances and nobody profits.

tavern/nessa-reedpath.body:
## Across the table

> I keep what I carry. You will have to come through my companions to reach me.

## When the guest wins

> You spent your strength on my shields. Try going around them next time.

## When the keeper wins

> The bridge held until you found the far bank. A fair delivery.

## At a draw

> Both letters lost in the same river. We will write again.

tavern/tora-ashward.body:
## Across the table

> A warm hearth and ready defenders. Come in, and come slowly.

## When the guest wins

> My companions outlasted yours. Growth beats haste over a long evening.

## When the keeper wins

> You struck before my hearth was warm. Well timed.

## At a draw

> Two tired households. There is still bread for both.

tavern/vey-mossglass.body:
## Across the table

> What falls at my table tends to be remembered, and what is remembered tends to return.

## When the guest wins

> Every companion you removed came back with a grudge. Answer the memory, not just the card.

## When the keeper wins

> You left nothing worth recovering. A tidy, cruel victory.

## At a draw

> Two empty shelves. Something will be found for next time.

tavern/pella-copperstring.body:
## Across the table

> My songs need a lead. Expect a Hero on the table before the second verse.

## When the guest wins

> The chorus carried it. Strike the singer before the song gets going.

## When the keeper wins

> You silenced my lead early. The rest of the band could not carry it.

## At a draw

> A duet with no ending. Audiences hate those.

tavern/adra-honeyreed.body:
## Across the table

> The hive swarms before the keeper is ready. So do I.

## When the guest wins

> A swarm early is worth a dragon late. Block small, block early.

## When the keeper wins

> You smoked the hive calm before it could sting. Clever keeper.

## At a draw

> Both of us stung out at once. The honey keeps.

tavern/hobb-lanternwake.body:
## Across the table

> I take the quiet crossings. Watch for what comes over the water, not across it.

## When the guest wins

> You guarded the road and I took the river. A ferryman's habit.

## When the keeper wins

> You met me at the landing with a lantern. Nothing to be done about that.

## At a draw

> The current took both boats. We will meet on the far bank.

tavern/dorr-slatefoot.body:
## Across the table

> I lay each stone where it will stay. Try moving one.

## When the guest wins

> You wore yourself out on my wall. Walls are what I do.

## When the keeper wins

> You found the loose stone. Every wall has one, if you are patient.

## At a draw

> Two walls, no roof. Still a dry night.

tavern/ysra-paleink.body:
## Across the table

> I keep an account of every threat. Most of them end up filed.

## When the guest wins

> Each of your important spells was noted and answered. Vary the ledger.

## When the keeper wins

> I answered the wrong page. The account is yours this time.

## At a draw

> A ledger closed in balance. Rare, and oddly satisfying.

tavern/mira-wickward.body:
## Across the table

> A small light that cannot be reached outlasts a big one that can.

## When the guest wins

> You never reached my lamps. Bring something that can climb.

## When the keeper wins

> You had the reach to snuff every wick. Dark, but fair.

## At a draw

> Both lamps out together. Dawn will come anyway.

tavern/jory-claythumb.body:
## Across the table

> I shape fast and fire early. Slow hands lose the pot.

## When the guest wins

> Fired before you set. Keep a blocker for the first kiln.

## When the keeper wins

> You let my clay cool. A patient hand beats a quick one, sometimes.

## At a draw

> Both pots cracked in the kiln. There is more clay.

tavern/sella-bellrest.body:
## Across the table

> I defend what I carry, and I carry a great deal. Take your time.

## When the guest wins

> Each companion you sent was met and remembered. Try the air, or many at once.

## When the keeper wins

> You broke through the quiet. I will add this evening to my names.

## At a draw

> Both bells rung at once. A strange, fair silence.

tavern/iven-shardwake.body:
## Across the table

> My Hero is the mirror; my spells are the light. Watch which one you answer.

## When the guest wins

> You spent your answers on my spells, and my Hero finished the work. Mind the mirror.

## When the keeper wins

> You broke the mirror before it caught the light. Cleanly done.

## At a draw

> Two mirrors facing. Nobody can tell which reflection fell first.

tavern/branna-briarstitch.body:
## Across the table

> Cut my hedge if you like. Hedges grow back thicker.

## When the guest wins

> Every trade favored the briar. Do not fight me stem for stem.

## When the keeper wins

> You went over rather than through. The hedge admits defeat.

## At a draw

> Both paths overgrown. We will cut them again.

tavern/odel-rimefolio.body:
## Across the table

> I write slowly and answer only what matters. Do not expect me to waste ink.

## When the guest wins

> I answered the few spells that counted and let the rest drift. Keep your ink dry.

## When the keeper wins

> I held my answers for a storm that never came. A page for you, keeper.

## At a draw

> Snow on both ledgers. The season decides nothing.

## Sallow orchard cider

Orchard apples, Spring water.

## Ale-braised harvest pie

Milled flour, Root vegetables, Amber hearth ale.

## Mead-glazed roots

Root vegetables, Garden herbs, Honey & hedgerow mead.

## Wayfarer’s mushroom broth

Forest mushrooms, Garden herbs, Spring water.

## Keeper’s cheese board

Aged cheese, Orchard apples, Hearth bread.

## Honey hearth tarts

Milled flour, Churned butter, Wild honey.

## Roadside mushroom pasties

Milled flour, Forest mushrooms, Churned butter.

## Spiced cider cake

Milled flour, Orchard apples, Warming spice, Sallow orchard cider.

## The long-table feast loaf

Milled flour, Aged cheese, Garden herbs, Amber hearth ale.

## Candlekeeper’s reserve mead

Honey & hedgerow mead, Wild honey, Warming spice.

## Midnight berry cordial

Hedgerow berries, Wild honey, Spring water.
